rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples and single parents living with children or supported persons: the cantonal income tax is reduced by 35%, at least CHF 680 and at most CHF 4,900 (art. 32 al. 3 let. a LF, amounts indexed from 2025)

rows.label: Interpolation (art. 32 al. 2 LF)
rows.value: Between the minimum and maximum the rate is interpolated; fractions below CHF 100 are ignored

rows.label: Child deduction from the cantonal tax (art. 31a LF)
rows.value: Up to CHF 300 per child

Church tax, Reformed
rows.value: None listed (ESTV: –)

rows.label: Church tax, Roman Catholic
rows.value: 3% of the communal tax (ESTV note 8)

source.title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

sections.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Sion; other communes in Valais set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).

sections.note: The federal profit tax of 8.5% comes on top (national page). Simple rates are multiplied by the cantonal and communal multipliers where a canton uses them; each canton may raise the rate for companies in international groups where a foreign state requires a minimum tax.

rows.label: Cantonal property tax on real estate of legal entities

source.title: ESTV Steuermäppchen Liegenschaftssteuer: Besteuerung der Liegenschaften (tax period 2025, document dated 26.11.2025)

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Valais)

rows.label: Communal additional duty
rows.value: At most 50% of the cantonal duty

source.title: Valais Loi sur les droits de mutations (LDM, RS 643.1) du 15.03.2012, état 01.01.2013 (current version)

sections.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
